caption:
Construction and trades businesses often wait on progress payments or retention amounts, while materials and labour costs are due upfront. Invoice finance and equipment finance are commonly used to bridge these gaps and fund vehicles or tools.

Every industry has its own rhythm when it comes to cash flow and finance needs — understanding construction and trades businesses's specific pattern is the first step to finding the right fit.

Progress payments, retentions and upfront materials costs all shape how construction businesses manage cash flow.
